plan.summary: Computed onboarding status API that aggregates from 3 sources (tenant_registry direct DB, Knowledge stats HTTP, Automation stats HTTP) into a single GET /api/v1/onboarding/status endpoint with graceful degradation.
plan.q_intent: Onboarding wizard icin computed status API gerekiyor. Tenant'in onboarding ilerlemesi 3 servisten alinip tek endpoint'te birlestiriliyor.
plan.interview_notes: No new tables/migrations. 7-step checklist with configurable thresholds. Graceful degradation: downstream failure returns partial data with detail=bilinmiyor.

files_changed.change: 5 DTOs: OnboardingStatusDto, OnboardingStepDto, OnboardingNextStepDto, KnowledgeOnboardingStatsDto, AutomationOnboardingStatsDto
Added INV-BE-050, INV-KN-036, INV-AT-038 error codes
Added ProxyGetAsync + private ProxyRequestAsync (following KnowledgeClient pattern)
Aggregation service: tenant_registry + Knowledge HTTP + Automation HTTP, graceful degradation, 7-step checklist
DI registration + GET /api/v1/onboarding/status endpoint + discovery entry + using

verification_questions.question: Does each downstream service call (Knowledge, Automation) use graceful degradation so a service failure does not crash the aggregated endpoint?
Are the service-to-service HTTP calls authenticated with JwtGenerator.GenerateServiceToken, not forwarding the caller's raw token?
Do the Knowledge and Automation onboarding-stats endpoints validate tenant ownership via GetValidatedTenant before returning data?
Are all 3 new error codes (INV-BE-050, INV-KN-036, INV-AT-038) registered in ErrorCodes.cs and used consistently in catch blocks?
Is the progress_pct calculation correct: (completed steps / 7) * 100, rounded to integer?

intentional_exclusions: No migration files - uses existing tables only

user_facing_errors: INV-BE-050: Failed to compute onboarding status
INV-KN-036: Failed to retrieve onboarding stats
INV-AT-038: Failed to retrieve onboarding stats
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All catch blocks either log warnings (degraded path) or return error responses with proper error codes. No empty catches.
